files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Local_Health_Boards_December_2023_WA_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Local_Health_Boards_December_2023_WA_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 7 features in WGS84.
